question: What single purifying agent in the world is capable of purifying all things?
premises: There is one purifying thing in the world.
That thing is identified as uniquely purifying.
It has the capacity to purify all.
inference: A single purifying agent is declared capable of purifying everything.
uncertainties: The referent of tat is not explicitly named in this verse
